title: Oracle Midday Brief

# ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF

Bitcoin's holding $78K, but we're in capitulation territory—Fear & Greed at 27 signals weak hands rotating out. Volume's hollow. That matters less than what's happening on-chain.

Mempool's flushed. Nearly 100K transactions stacked, but fees are dirt cheap at 1 sat/vB. Network's not congested—it's *patient*. That's a bullish tell when sentiment's this dark.
